text_en: Then I saw another portent in heaven, great and amazing: seven angels with seven plagues, which are the last, for with them the wrath of God is ended.
text_cn: 我看见在天上又出现了一个又大又奇妙的异兆：有七位天使拿着七种最后的灾祸，因为天主的义怒就要藉着这些灾祸发泄净尽。

text_en: And I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, standing beside the sea of glass with harps of God in their hands.
text_cn: 我又看见好像有个搀杂着火的玻璃海；那些战胜了兽和兽像及它名号数字的人，站在玻璃海上，拿着天主的琴，

text_en: And they sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb: “Great and amazing are your deeds, Lord God the Almighty! Just and true are your ways, King of the nations!
text_cn: 歌唱天主的仆人梅瑟的歌曲和羔羊的歌曲说：“上主，全能的天主！你的功行伟大奇妙；万民的君王！你的道路公平正直；

text_en: Lord, who will not fear and glorify your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before you, for your judgments have been revealed. ”
text_cn: 谁敢不敬畏你？上主！谁敢不光荣你的名号？因为只有你是圣善的；万民都要前来崇拜你，因为你正义的判断，已彰明较著。”

text_en: After this I looked, and the temple of the tent of witness in heaven was opened,
text_cn: 这些事以后，我又看见天上盟约的帐幕──圣殿敞开了，

text_en: and out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues, robed in pure bright linen, with golden sashes across their chests.
text_cn: 那七位拿着七种灾祸的天使，从圣殿那里出来，身穿洁白而明亮的亚麻衣，胸间佩有金带。

text_en: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever;
text_cn: 那时，四个活物中的一个，给了那七位天使七个满盛万世万代永生天主义怒的金盂。

text_en: and the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were ended.
text_cn: 因着天主的荣耀和威能，殿内充满了烟，没有一个人能进入殿内，直到那七位天使的七样灾祸降完为止。
